*** Correction on 10/26/2026 ***

Livestock Weighted Average Report for 10/23/2026 - Final

AUCTION
                                                          This Week                   Last Reported                      Last Year
                                                                                       10/16/2026
Total Receipts:                                          7,030                         5,323                           6,320
Feeder Cattle:                                           7,030(100.0%)                 5,323(100.0%)                   6,320(100.0%)

Special Note: Correction to narrative

Compared to last week: Steer calves 350-400 lbs, sharply higher on a light test, 400-550 lbs, 15.00-20.00 higher, 550-600 lbs steady to 2.00
higher, 600-650 lbs 20.00 higher. Heifer calves 350-600 lbs sharply higher, 400-450 lbs, 7.00 higher, 450-550 lbs unevenly steady, 550-600 lbs
11.00 lower, 600-650 lbs 20.00 lower. Good demand for lots of nice, open haired, fully vaccinated calves. Load lots and larger packages of
black hided, fully vaccinated topped most weights. Most of the offering was home raised and right off the cow, however, there were a few
fully weaned lots and packages showing a little tagg from the feed lots. The market was active for most of the day, but turned more
moderate towards the end of the sale, creating some larger spreads. The next sale is the last Wednesday special, October 28, starting at
noon, with the regular Friday sale, October 30, starting at 8. Supply included: 100% Feeder Cattle (51% Steers, 49% Heifers). Feeder cattle
supply over 600 lbs was 15%.
